About Caldwell

Career support informed by real hiring experience.

Caldwell Career Consulting was founded by Jonathan Caleb to help professionals tell their story clearly and make considered decisions about what comes next.

Founder story

A practical perspective on career growth.

After more than a decade in executive search, Jonathan saw how often capable professionals struggled to communicate their impact—not because they lacked experience, but because their career documents and interview stories did not make that experience clear.

Caldwell brings that hiring perspective to career coaching, resume and CV writing, and professional documents. The work is personal, collaborative, and grounded in each client's goals.

What to expect

Thoughtful, personal career support.

Listen first

Understand your experience, priorities, and the change you want to make before deciding what support is right.

Make your strengths clear

Turn responsibilities and achievements into a focused professional story that reflects your real contribution.

Work collaboratively

Develop career documents and plans together, with room for your perspective and voice.

Agree on the details

Scope, timing, and fees are discussed clearly before any engagement begins.

Work with Caldwell

Start with the conversation that matters to you.
